newsitem.title: USA: PLC says TMR heart treatment moves forward.
newsitem.headline: PLC says TMR heart treatment moves forward.

text.p: PLC Systems Inc said Tuesday it received "positive" feedback from the Food and Drug Administration for its heart laser treatment known as transmyocardial revascularization.
Patricia Murphy, PLC chief financial officer, said the FDA is no longer requiring PLC to separate patients in clinical trials into groups of those treated by TMR and those treated by drugs.
"They are not requiring us to continue to create comparison pools," Murphy said. "It would seem to us to be a positive move by the FDA."
In the company's comparison study, the mortality rate among patients treated by TMR was 6 percent, and the mortality rate among those treated by drugs was 16 percent, the company said.
Tom Wikcy, a spokesman for PLC, said the company hopes that TMR laser treatment can become an alternative to bypass surgery and angioplasty.
